title: Apex Girls
summary: Meet 100+ unique mech girls in a fallen world! Log in to claim up to 18,250 free pulls and recruit your favorite Stellaris. Mix roles and factions to build a powerful squad, explore diverse game modes, and fight alongside your girls to save the world!
about:
As civilization crumbles beneath the iron heel of the Calamity, girls gifted with extraordinary power become humanity’s last hope.

Become a Commander and meet over 100 unique mech girls known as the “Stellaris.” Recruit and develop your favorite companions, then assemble a squad of your own. Journey across the perilous wastelands of the apocalypse, fight alongside the girls against the Calamity, and reclaim humanity’s lost homeland!

Apex Girls is a post-apocalyptic sci-fi idle RPG featuring a diverse cast of powerful heroines. Gather upgrade resources with ease, freely customize your battle lineup, and immerse yourself in a rich story with a wide variety of game modes. Collect your favorite characters, develop them at your own pace, and enjoy thrilling strategic battles!

◇ Log in daily for 50 free pulls—claim up to 18,250 pulls in total!

Simply log in each day to receive 50 free pulls. Earn up to 18,250 pulls through cumulative login rewards, with even more surprises waiting for you!

Keep recruiting new Stellaris and expand your roster with ease. Whether you want to collect more of your favorite girls or reinforce your core squad, every daily login brings new rewards and new surprises!

◇ Over 100 mech girls are waiting to meet you!

The Stellaris have assembled, each with her own unique personality and style!

Meet more than 100 captivating girls, admire their stunning character artwork, and develop your favorite companions. Help the Stellaris grow to unlock new forms, dazzling outfits, and even greater combat power, allowing every girl to shine in her own way!

◇ Mix and match to build your ultimate squad!

Choose five members from among the many Stellaris and assemble a battle squad of your own.

Mix and match characters based on their roles, faction matchups, and skill synergies. Find the perfect balance of damage dealers, tanks, healers, and supports. Adapt your squad to different enemies and battlefield conditions, and make your favorite girl the heart of your team!

◇ Effortless idle play—even offline, your squad keeps growing!

Even while you are away, the Stellaris will continue fighting and gathering the resources needed to develop your characters.

Use battle speed-up and skip features to breeze through daily content, leaving more time to refine your lineup, develop your characters, and enjoy the modes you truly love. Whether you prefer quick daily sessions or in-depth team building, you can enjoy the adventure at your own pace!

◇ Deep progression systems make your squad even stronger!

Recruiting new Stellaris is only the first step in their development.

Collect and upgrade mechs, weapons, and pets to explore new development options for different characters and team compositions. Build your progression plan around your favorite girls, discover new combinations and tactics, and push your squad beyond its limits one step at a time!

◇ Take on a variety of challenges across multiple game modes!

Follow the main story and explore a post-apocalyptic world as you gradually uncover the secrets behind the Calamity and the Star Cores. Challenge a variety of PvE stages and powerful bosses to put your squad’s strength to the test.

You can also compete in PvP, join guild and multiplayer activities, fight alongside other Commanders, or test your skills against them in the arena!

This game includes optional in-app purchases and purchasable virtual currency that may be used to obtain in-game content, including randomized virtual items.
